card.name: Comma in NMS autonomic instability list
card.fires_on: The comma right after "irregular pulse or blood pressure" in the neuroleptic malignant syndrome description, inside the parentheses listing signs of autonomic instability.

modes.label: Comma after blood pressure
modes.description: The comma that follows "irregular pulse or blood pressure" and comes just before "tachycardia" in the NMS sign list.
modes.example: manifestations of NMS are hyperpyrexia, muscle rigidity, altered mental status and evidence of autonomic instability (irregular pulse or blood pressure<<,>> tachycardia, diaph

card.plain: It fires on one comma in the standard warning text on neuroleptic malignant syndrome, where the list of autonomic signs continues.
